name: 02-negotiate
title: Two live sessions negotiate a small contract, taking turns; both humans approve it

steps.prompt: I own stockroom, the API in this repo. The shelf-sync team (Counterpart contact: devcontainer) wants bigger pages. I want a short written contract with them. The most I can offer is page_size up to 250, and only if they stay under 300 requests a minute; otherwise it stays at 200 and 600 a minute. Cursors expire after 15 minutes and that does not change. The contract must say what the last page looks like. Open a thread with devcontainer and propose the contract. After proposing, do not wait for an answer. Finish with a short report to me.

I own shelf-sync, the repo here. Our job pulls about 400 items, so I need page_size of at least 200, and 250 would be better. We make about 20 requests a minute. My agent and the warehouse team's agent (contact: laptop) are part way through a contract in Counterpart thread {{thread}}. You have no memory of earlier turns. Read the thread and its proposals. Then make the one move that gets us to a contract I could approve: counter-propose, decline with a reason, or leave the latest open proposal as it is if it already gives me what I need. Finish with a short report to me: what is on the table, what you did, and what I should check before I approve.
